summary: Input/event state updater with optional attached payload copy. Guarded on the object's type ID matching a2 and on the time delta a3 - *(double*)(this+4) staying below 2.0. On success stores the new value a3 across this+0x10/0x14, sets the update flag byte at this+0xC to 1, writes the blended result v6*0.5+a4 as a double at this+0x18, then either zeroes the payload size at this+0x120 (a6 out of [1,254]) or stores a6 and copies a6 bytes from a5 into this+0x20; returns 1, else 0.

operations.description: If a2 does not equal *(DWORD*)this (the object's type/identifier field), return 0 without updating.
Compute the time delta v6 = a3 - *(double*)(this+4) against the stored previous value.
If v6 >= 2.0 the update is stale/out of range; return 0.
Store the incoming value a3 into this+0x10 (low dword) and this+0x14 (high dword) as a packed double.
Set the byte at this+0xC to 1 to flag a successful state update.
Write the blended/lerped result v6 * 0.5 + a4 as a double at this+0x18.
If a6 <= 0 or a6 >= 255, the payload size at this+0x120 is set to 0 (no attached data).
Otherwise store a6 into this+0x120 and copy a6 bytes from the a5 buffer into this+0x20 via qmemcpy.
Return 1 on a successful state update; 0 on both guard failures.
